title: Catastrophic backtracking in link detection
body:
The link regex at pastebox/render.py line 6 has a nested quantifier, so a long line of non-space characters makes rendering take exponential time.

Vulnerable line:

```python
LINK_RE = re.compile(r"(https?://\S+)+$")
```

Steps:

1. Create a paste whose body is http:// followed by 50,000 letters and one trailing space.
2. Request the paste page.
3. The request does not complete.
